root_cause: The old breaker counted consecutive archive failures and reset after any verified existing archive tag. In the original postmerge native run, that allowed six distinct new-tag HTTP403 permission errors even though a three-strike provider guard was expected.
fix: Maintain a monotonic per-run budget of native CREATE_ARCHIVE_TAG HTTP403 permission denials independent of intervening successful exact-SHA tag readbacks; terminate all further provider API calls at three; record total and circuit-open flag in existing native source artifact.
preventive_rule: NO_TAG_CREATE_403_CIRCUIT_RESET_WITHIN_RUN_NO_FOURTH_DENIED_POST. Keep the original archive job red on denied writes, keep exact unique branches untouched until a provider-authorized matching tag exists, and retain original GitHub incident + ONE BRAIN dual reporting/readback without duplication.
